description: This source file defines data structures and functions related to parsing and handling talk provider configurations, including selecting providers, resolving timeouts, and normalizing provider IDs.

methods.name: bridgeFoundationDictionary
methods.description: Converts an optional raw dictionary of type [String: Any]? to a dictionary with values of type AnyCodable.

methods.name: selectProviderConfig
methods.description: Selects a provider configuration based on input dictionary, default provider, and fallback allowance.

methods.name: resolvedPositiveInt
methods.description: Resolves an AnyCodable value to an integer, with fallback if invalid.

methods.name: resolvedSilenceTimeoutMs
methods.description: Resolves the silence timeout in milliseconds from the provided talk dictionary or fallback.

methods.name: normalizedTalkProviderID
methods.description: Normalizes a provider ID string by trimming whitespace and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: resolvedProviderConfig
methods.description: Resolves the provider configuration from the talk dictionary if possible.
